summary_en: Correction to reference data disclosed 2024-06-23. Shares outstanding (ex-treasury) restated to 12,715,840; treasury holdings restated to 23,856 shares. J-ESOP trust holdings (452,800 shares) explicitly excluded from treasury count. No change to buyback program itself.
title_en: Correction to Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Exchange Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Kuribayashi Steamship filed a correction on 24 June 2024 to reference data disclosed the prior day (23 June 2024) concerning a treasury-share acquisition program using ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trading. The correction addresses the count of shares outstanding (excluding treasury) and treasury holdings as of 23 June 2024. Shares outstanding (ex-treasury) are restated from 12,352,945 to 12,715,840 shares; treasury holdings are restated from 386,751 to 23,856 shares. The filing explicitly clarifies that the 452,800 shares held by the J-ESOP (share-grant trust) are excluded from the treasury count. The correction affects only the reference data; the buyback program itself and its terms remain unchanged.
